composition_owner.description: Current controlling publisher or administrator of the underlying composition (the written work), as of today

publisher_of_record.description: Publisher of record named by a PRO or registry entry; may differ from the current administrator

master_owner.description: Owner of this specific sound recording; differs from the composition owner, especially for cover recordings

is_cover.description: True if the recording used is a cover, not the original master

catalog_transfers.description: Every ownership hop found, oldest first. Trace acquisitions forward to today's controller.

litigation_signals.description: Disputes, suits, probate or estate contests touching either chain. Any entry forces a RED risk state.

conflicting_sources.description: True when sources disagree about control. Never silently resolve a conflict — report both.

conflict_note.description: If conflicting_sources is true, state each position and which source supports it

unresolved_questions.description: What could not be established from public sources

confidence.description: 0.0-1.0 confidence that both chains are correctly identified as of today
